p.src: 1  Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

ja: ミリアムとアロンは、モーセが妻にしたクシュ人の
した。モーセがクシュ人の女を妻にしていたからである。
en: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
u.src: 1  Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

p.src: 2  They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.

ja: はモーセを通してだけ
られたのだろうか。私たちを通しても
en: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.
u.src: 2  They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.

p.src: 3  Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

en: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
u.src: 3  Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

p.src: 4  The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

ja: 、モーセとアロンとミリアムに
en: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
u.src: 4  The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

p.src: 5  The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

ja: って、アロンとミリアムを
en: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
u.src: 5  The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

p.src: 6  He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

ja: きなさい。あなたがたの
en: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
u.src: 6  He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

p.src: 7  My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

ja: わたしのしもべモーセはそうではない。
en: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
u.src: 7  My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

p.src: 8  With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

ja: とは面と向かって、明らかに
る。それなのに、なぜあなたがたは恐れもせず、わたしのしもべモーセを
en: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
u.src: 8  With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

p.src: 9  The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

en: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
u.src: 9  The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

p.src: 10  The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

ja: よ、ミリアムは重い皮膚病にかかり、
くなっていた。アロンがミリアムを
en: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
u.src: 10  The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

p.src: 11  Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

ja: よ。私たちは愚かなことをして罪を犯しました。どうか、この
en: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
u.src: 11  Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

p.src: 12  Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

ja: 分食い尽くされている
人のようにしないでください。」
en: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
u.src: 12  Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

p.src: 13  Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

en: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
u.src: 13  Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

p.src: 14  The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

en: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
u.src: 14  The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

p.src: 15  Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

ja: はミリアムが連れ戻されるまで
en: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
u.src: 15  Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

p.src: 16  Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

ja: はハツェロトから旅立ち、パランの
en: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
u.src: 16  Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
